properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): the design-merge rule is written ONCE, at install, for a CONVENTIONAL export path (docs/design/<project>.json) — a project whose committed export lives anywhere else, or that predates the installer step, silently keeps git's line merge, and nothing checks the export a design actually syncs with
properties.source: hxm_program field report F-27 (AJ's work session, 2026-09-23), root-caused from the dev_reflow2 hub with the root-cause skill; reflow2 origin/main tools/reflow2_init.py (ensure_gitattributes, design_record_path), AGENTS.md; hxm_program git history
properties.statement:
① OBSERVED (hxm_program, F-27): the hub-transition plan (written from the dev_reflow2 hub on 2026-09-23) told each clone to run `git config merge.reflow2.driver …` and said nothing about `.gitattributes`. The work session found that git config alone does nothing until `.gitattributes` names the file, added `reflow2.json merge=reflow2` and `designs/*/design.json merge=reflow2`, and noted "nothing in reflow2 would have said so". hxm_program's `.gitattributes` did not exist before that commit (346dbf8), although its design export has been committed since 2026-08-25.

② PRECEDENT: cap:the-design-record-merges-per-node-in-every-clone (built, #174, 2026-08-14) is exactly this mechanism, and this requirement rules both halves are one mechanism ("a driver without the repo-side rule is inert and the silent line-merge survives untouched").

③–⑤ CANDIDATES AND MEASUREMENTS:
  (a) The plan copied reflow2's own instruction. CONFIRMED: AGENTS.md's one-time setup says ".gitattributes points…" and then gives only the two git config lines, because reflow2's repo already carries the rule. Carried into a consumer's plan, the implicit half was lost. This is the TRIGGER (the dev_reflow2 session wrote the plan), not the cause.
  (b) The installer cannot cover hxm's export. CONFIRMED: ensure_gitattributes names design_record_path(project) = `docs/design/<project>.json`, a fixed convention. hxm_program's committed export is `reflow2.json` at the repo root (D-0016, 2026-08-25), so even a run of the installer would have written a rule for a file hxm does not have.
  (c) Nothing checks later. CONFIRMED: no code in crates/ or tools/ calls `git check-attr`; `loop_status.sync` knows each committed export a design syncs with, and never asks whether git will merge it per node.
  (d) The observation is wrong. REFUTED: git merge drivers apply only to paths an attribute names; the repo had none.

⑥ THE CLASS: the requirement asks that each silent step "SAYS what it needs", and it is met only at INSTALL time and only for the CONVENTIONAL path. Anything chosen later or differently — a root-level export, a second design in a subfolder (hxm's designs/*/design.json), a project set up before #174 — is undefended, and the fallback (a line merge on a multi-megabyte JSON) is silent. Fixing the plan's wording fixes this instance only.

WHAT WOULD FIX THE CLASS, not built: check at USE time against the REAL path — for each export `loop_status.sync` tracks, `git check-attr merge <path>`, and a line when it is not `reflow2` (plus a driver-not-configured line when `merge.reflow2.driver` is unset in this clone); and have the installer write the rule for the export path the project actually uses (its `--export-to`) rather than the convention. The ideas are recorded as a brainstorm.

⚠️ AND ONE REQUIREMENT WOULD RETIRE THE WHOLE CONCERN: req:the-saved-design-merges-correctly-under-gits-ordinary-merge (accepted 2026-09-23, unbuilt) makes a design merge correctly with NO driver. Until it is built, the driver is load-bearing.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether hxm_program ever ran the installer in-repo at all (it has no committed .mcp.json); how many other consumer projects keep their export off the conventional path.
